about_the_game:
Furry Fantasy Adult World is an open-world adult game where you can have fun exploring and interacting with fantasy characters, either alone, online, or with bots (NPCs).

Features:

  • Anthro and feral fantasy furry characters (not real).

  • Customize your characters to your liking.

  • Explore the world and also you can even have your companion follow you.

  • Relax and have fun with each unique in-game experience.

  • Customize your graphics options.

  • Built-in dialogue and NSFW sounds.

  • Enable or disable any fetish from the menu.

  • Enable or disable fur rendering if applicable to the character.

  • Ability to create public or local servers for online play (no built-in chat).

  • More!

This game does not include or is powered by AI. All characters are of legal age and consent to the sexual acts performed in the game. Each character is already scaled to adult size. The user must manually enable and consent to enable feral fantasy characters/animations if required. You can only enable one type of avatar in the world... anthros or ferals, you can't enable both for obvious reasons.

This game was developed in Argentina based on the Unreal Engine 5 with DirectX12 and blueprint only for a unique and interactive experience.
